record_title: Exact classification of infinitary harmonic numbers with four I-components
scientific_context: The infinitary harmonic numbers with exactly four I-components are classified completely as 270, 420, 630, 9100, 46494 and 646425. Combined with the published J<=3 classification, this gives the complete list for J<=4.
limitations: The theorem treats exactly four I-components and does not address J>=5 or the open infinitude question. Completeness uses a finite exact computer-assisted enumeration with proved bounds; no formal proof-assistant verification is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from unindexed or differently phrased literature.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact enumeration proving completeness of the four-I-component classification.
